findings.claim: Line 41 (and cautions line 58) says the time ranges come from the chapter markers on the YouTube watch page. This video's description publishes creator chapters at 00:00, 01:00 and 02:50, and YouTube uses creator chapters from the description in place of automatic ones, so the watch-page markers should be 0:00, 1:00 and 2:50. The covers ranges (0:41, 2:22, 4:05) do not fall on those markers, so they cannot come from the chapter markers as stated; they presumably come from the captions. The ranges themselves are plausible and no learner is misled about content, but the stated source is inaccurate for this file.
